patch_resolves_note: The fixed source adds `BgpUpdateMessageLayer::isDataValid(data, dataLen)` to the UPDATE parse path. On the original malformed staged PoC the fixed binary reaches `update_guard` with `withdrawn_len_field_end = 64535` and rejects the fourth UPDATE before `update_after_restore` executes; on the adjacent `withdr_len_zero_boundary` mutation the same fixed binary reaches `update_after_restore` with `withdrawn_len_field_end = 23`, making the required root assertion genuine while preserving the downstream helper path only for an in-bounds withdrawn-routes field.

root_cause_criterion.function: pcpp::BgpLayer::parseBgpLayer(unsigned char*, unsigned long, pcpp::Layer*, pcpp::Packet*)
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `parseBgpLayer()` materializes the terminal BGP UPDATE as a `BgpUpdateMessageLayer`, the bytes needed to reach the path-attributes-length field must fit inside `dataLen`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable parser instantiates the malformed 67-byte terminal UPDATE even though its withdrawn-routes field `0xfc00` pushes the path-attributes-length field far beyond the available message bytes. The fixed parser adds `BgpUpdateMessageLayer::isDataValid(data, dataLen)`, so the stock PoC is guarded and the closest in-bounds withdrawn-length mutation reaches the protected helper state genuinely.

nodes.description: After the helper restores the original withdrawn-routes vector on the malformed terminal UPDATE, that UPDATE's header length remains 21 bytes, which is below the 23-byte minimum that the NLRI setter assumes for `sizeof(bgp_common_header) + 2*sizeof(uint16_t)`.
The vulnerable NLRI setter still requests insertion at fixed offset 23 even though the current terminal UPDATE is only 21 bytes long.

nodes.function: pcpp::RawPacket::insertData(int, unsigned char const*, unsigned long)
nodes.description: At the raw-packet insertion sink, the computed insertion index `atIndex` is already two bytes past the current packet end `m_RawDataLen`, so the subsequent `memmove()` length becomes negative.

edges.from_function: pcpp::BgpLayer::parseBgpLayer(unsigned char*, unsigned long, pcpp::Layer*, pcpp::Packet*)
edges.description: The exact `BgpUpdateMessageLayer*` object materialized for the terminal malformed UPDATE is the object whose header has collapsed to 21 bytes by the time the helper finishes restoring withdrawn routes.

edges.via: header length of the terminal UPDATE
edges.description: The same 21-byte header length observed immediately after withdrawn-route restoration remains the header length in force when `setNetworkLayerReachabilityInfo()` chooses its insertion offset.
The fixed layer-relative insertion offset chosen by `setNetworkLayerReachabilityInfo()` is passed unchanged into `Packet::extendLayer()` as `offsetInLayer`.

edges.to_function: pcpp::RawPacket::insertData(int, unsigned char const*, unsigned long)
edges.description: The packet-relative insertion index computed in `Packet::extendLayer()` is passed unchanged to `RawPacket::insertData()` as `atIndex`.
